description: "I do not support socialism. I have not supported socialism. And I will not support socialism. I am a capitalist. More specifically, I believe in rules-based capitalism—an economic system built on private property, entrepreneurship, voluntary exchange, consumer choice, and free and competitive markets."

title: I Do Not Support Socialism: Why I Believe in Rules-Based Capitalism
